column2: I have keys but open no locks. I have space but no room. You can enter, but cannot go inside. What am I?
The more you take from me, the bigger I become. What am I?
I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but come alive with sound. What am I?
I have hands but cannot clap. I have a face but cannot smile. What am I?
I get wetter the more I dry. What am I?
What has many teeth but cannot bite?
What can travel around the world while staying in one corner?
I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and rivers but no water. What am I?
What belongs to you but other people use it more than you do?
The more there is of me, the less you can see. What am I?
